view.name: Mission summary with score
view.description: Immersive-mode end-of-session summary with a three-tier star score (Tiro/Proficiens/Peritus), feedback card, fork-on-GitHub panel and Back to Mission List button.

regions.label: Minimal top bar with dashed-outline GitHub Source link and circular emoji theme toggle
'Mission Accomplished!' heading and three-tier star level display (Tiro/Proficiens/Peritus) with achieved tier highlighted and caption
White elevated Feedback card with bulleted coaching notes
Dashed-outline 'Build Your Own Version' box with Fork on GitHub button
Full-width olive 'Back to mission list' primary button

evidence.note: White rounded (24px) card with shadow summarizing feedback; no actions
Second container is dashed-outlined, transparent, with one primary action (Fork on GitHub)
Star tiers are read-only earned-level display, not an input (not interactive on hover/no buttons in a11y tree)
Tier display is not a numeric KPI tile
Success heading is a page title, not a banner

structure.layout: single centered narrow column (472px) results screen with minimal top-right header, stacked heading, tier display, feedback card, CTA box and full-width primary button

aesthetics.typography: Libre Baskerville (bold serif) for headings, tier names and card titles; Nunito (rounded sans) for body, list items and buttons (800 weight on buttons, uppercase letter-spaced on primary button)
aesthetics.typeScale: Modest: h2 24px/700 serif, h3 19px serif olive, h4 16px serif, body 16px Nunito, buttons 18–20px/800, caption 14px italic

notes: Warm cream paper background with olive green (#5c6b48) brand. Distinctive dashed 2px olive borders on secondary link buttons (Source, Fork on GitHub) and a thin dashed outline on the 'Build your own' box, giving a stitched/hand-made feel. Latin tier names (Tiro, Proficiens, Peritus) with 1/2/3 filled stars; unearned tiers greyed, earned tier black stars and olive serif label with italic caption '(No help, fluid)'. Emoji 💻 as theme toggle in a white circle. A completion/results-screen pattern is not in the codebook — proposed as completion-summary.
